- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day window, especially after recent spikes.
- Model overestimates prices in the middle to late part of the window, particularly when true values show a downward trend.
- Model tends to lag behind true values by 1–3 days, especially in the first 10 days of the forecast horizon.
- After a sharp price spike, model forecasts often overshoot and then correct, but the correction is too slow or too aggressive.
- Model exhibits mean reversion bias: it overcorrects downward after high prices and undercorrects upward after low prices.
- Model fails to capture the true price momentum in the last 5–7 days of the forecast, often underestimating upward trends.
- Model is overly sensitive to recent low prices, leading to premature downward bias.
- Model tends to ignore the influence of the 30-day moving average, underestimating its smoothing effect on price volatility.
